text.p: Swedish telephone equipment company LM Ericsson's American Depositary Receipts (ADRs) eased slightly Friday after the company posted strong earnings.

The company's ADRs were down 1/8 at 32-1/4 after Ericsson reported its first quarter earnings rose 30 percent, a bit more than the market expected. Earnings per share were 1.40 crowns against 1.09 crowns for the same period last year.
Ericsson was among the most-active ADRs on Wall Street.
Finnish telephone equipment company Nokia Group was off 1/4 to 59.
Akzo Nobel NV fell 2-5/8 to 66-3/8 after the Dutch chemical company reported a rise in first-quarter profits that was at the low end of expectations.
Telefonos de Mexico SA fell 3/8 to 41-3/8 after the Mexican telecommunications company reported mixed results for the first quarter.
Open outcry on the floor of the Mexican stock exchange was suspended Friday and screen trading alone took place because of a fire at the bourse after the close of trading Thursday.
Advancers led decliners 132 to 216 among 806 ADRs. The ADR group was off 0.20 percent in early morning and volume was 11 million shares.
